thesis: Time can generate historical and relational beauty while loss, decay and suffering remain losses.

ideas.statement: An original object may carry irreplaceable history beyond an identical copy; preserving beauty entails choices among use, safety, testimony and transformation.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: An admired ruin may be an inhabitant’s danger; greater attention through threatened loss does not make loss itself good.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: An admired ruin may be an inhabitant’s danger; greater attention through threatened loss does not make loss itself good.
